title: Expand requirements map to full BRIEF coverage; add strategy view, roadm
summary: Replace the 8-row sample in docs/design/requirements-map.md with a map covering every BRIEF.md requirement section (O1–O5, A1–A13, S1–S7, D1–D3, standards, addenda), each with cited evidence and a coverage grade. Add a strategy view (what is answered, partial, open, grouped by theme) and a roadmap ordering the gaps, in the same doc or a sibling doc, plus a changelog entry.

defaults_applied.how: Every row cites file:line evidence quoted from the repo; unmeasured claims are labeled as estimates or Open.
Docs are written for an outside reader with the line-number caveat and coverage definitions kept.
Docs only, one focused change: map, strategy view, roadmap, one changelog entry.
Scope of strategy view and roadmap recovered from the failed predecessor's findings and the BRIEF headings.
Verifier checks cited lines against quoted text and heading coverage against BRIEF.md.

assumptions: The strategy view and roadmap go in new docs under docs/design/ (strategy-view.md, roadmap.md) linked from the map; no README change.

Full means every numbered requirement heading in BRIEF.md (O1-O5, A1-A13, S1-S7, D1-D3, plus Standards, Boundaries and dated addenda) has at least one row, including rows graded Open where nothing answers it.
Coverage grades keep the existing Direct/Partial vocabulary and add Open for unanswered requirements.
Roadmap items are ordered by evidence in the repo (gaps found in the map), not invented new scope; no code changes.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/design/requirements-map.md has at least one row for every numbered requirement heading in BRIEF.md (O1-O5, A1-A13, S1-S7, D1-D3) and for Standards and each dated addendum; it no longer describes itself as a sample.
Each row has a BRIEF.md line citation whose number matches the quoted requirement and evidence with file:line citations, and a coverage grade of Direct, Partial or Open.
A strategy view groups the rows by theme and states counts of Direct, Partial and Open that match the map's rows.
A roadmap lists the Partial and Open items in a stated order with a rationale for the ordering, each linked to its map row.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry under Unreleased that describes the map as covering all requirement sections, plus the strategy view and roadmap, without overstating.
No secrets or personal data appear in the new docs, and no files other than docs and CHANGELOG.md change.
Run cargo test and cargo clippy from the repository root; both pass, since any doc-checking tests still hold.

out_of_scope: Code changes to close any gap the map finds
Changes to BRIEF.md, records/, or governance files
Verifying that requirements are met in full beyond citing evidence
departures: Larger than the reference: a full map over ~40 BRIEF requirements needs many file reads and line-accurate citations, which also raises the chance of a citation nit.
